newsitem.title: LATVIA: MOST LIEPAJAS SHARES BLOCKED AHEAD OF MEETING.
newsitem.headline: MOST LIEPAJAS SHARES BLOCKED AHEAD OF MEETING.

text.p: Most shares in Liepajas Metalurgs were blocked ahead of a shareholder meeting on June 21, the central depository said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement that 8.37 million shares had been blocked ahead of the shareholder meeting, out of a total 8.5 million shares in issue, meaning 121,305 shares were unblocked.
The largest shareholder in Liepajas is Gesil Ltd, with 72.04 percent of the shares, followed by the privatisation agency on 5.36 percent and the company La Brit Inn on 4.42 percent.
